intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Suffolk for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, with 6 new listings added to the 2 already live, 3 of the new ones free. The new listings run from November 27 (Festival of Lights at Sleepy Hole Park) through January 2 (3rd Annual Magical Christmas Tree Tour), with the Suffolk Holiday Parade (December 12), Bridgeport Holiday Market with Santa (December 5) and the Southside Ballet Nutcracker (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Suffolk

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Suffolk
  • 3 free new events, including the Suffolk Holiday Parade and the Festival of Lights at Sleepy Hole Park
  • Meet Santa: Bridgeport Holiday Market with Santa and Breakfast with Santa
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Suffolk Holiday Parade on December 12
  • Trains: Suffolk Seaboard Station Railroad Museum
  • Season: November 27 to January 2, 2027 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Suffolk families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers the Bayport Credit Union Holiday Trail of Lights at the Virginia Aquarium, Planes, Trains and Santa at the Military Aviation Museum and the Snow Globe Spectacular at Town Center.
